page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Cropped marginal notes run down the left edge. Running head at top, page number at top right, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~6 letters]nis,ut ueri ne sint sensus. alterum a-ctionis,quod refertur ad efficiendu quid: ut si quaeratur, quibus officijs amicitia colenda sit.Rursus superio ris genera sunt tria: Sit nec ne, quid sit, quale sit. Sit nec ne:ut, ius in na-tura sit,an in more. Quid autem sit, sit ne ius id, quod maiori parti sit u-tile.Quale autem sit: iuste uiuere sit nec ne utile,
[illegible, ~6 letters]Quamobrem prius de propositio dicamus.) His uerbis constat, Ciceronem cognitionis & actionis quaestiones sub propositum subijcere, eiusq; facere parteis.

[illegible, ~6 letters]Eius! scientia est finis.) Significat, nihil ultra scientiam in cognitionis quaestione quaerendum: ut intelligamus,ea inuenta quiescendum. nam actio nulla hic requiritur, sed mera consideratio, contemplatioq; naturae.

[illegible, ~6 letters]Vt ueri ne sint sensus.) An sint ueri sensus, docet Aristoteles in libro de Sensibus primo, & libro de Somnijs, cap.2. Sed Cicero praeclare in Acad.lib.4. Meo autem iudicio,inquit, ita est maxima in sensibus veritas,si & sani sunt, & valentes, & omnia remouentur quae obstant & impediunt.itaq; & lumen mutari saepe uolumus,& si-

page.notes: Left margin notes are cropped at the scan edge and cannot be read; each is marked illegible. The right edge is a neighbouring page and is left out. The catchword "tus" and signature "6" are read at the foot. Some marginal glyphs in the left margin are too damaged to transcribe.
